title: contribution
description: One itemized contribution from an individual (or a candidate) to a committee, as reported to the FEC, counted once: an earmark through a conduit is its recipient's row, and memo lines are left out but for orphaned attributions. A candidate's loans to their own campaign and their repayments are rows too, marked self-funding. Partitioned by cycle; a cycle's rows are split over many files.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The FEC's id of the row (`SUB_ID`), unique within a source.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

contributor_zip.description: The contributor's ZIP code as reported.

contributor_key.description: The contributor's normalized name, ZIP5, employer and occupation joined by `|`; the `contributor` table's key.

donor_id.description: The resolved donor the contribution is from, the `donor` table's key. Stable from snapshot to snapshot (the crosswalk), except where a donor is merged or split.

recipient_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee that received the contribution.

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the recipient committee raises for, when it is their principal or authorized committee; else null.

amount.description: The amount in dollars. A refund (types 2nY, 4nY) is negative whatever sign it was filed with, unless it reverses an earlier refund, and a loan repaid to the candidate (20C) is negative; any other amount is as filed. Refunds and corrections net out in any sum.

date.description: The date of the contribution as filed; null when the filer gave none.

entity_type.description: The FEC entity type of the contributor (`IND`, `CAN`), or null when the filing left it blank.

report_type.description: The FEC report the row was filed on (`Q1`, `12G`, `YE` …).

amendment_indicator.description: The FEC amendment indicator of the filing (`N` new, `A` amendment, `T` termination).

memo_text.description: The filer's memo text, as reported.

conduit_committee_id.description: The FEC id of the conduit (ActBlue, WinRed …) an earmarked contribution came through; null for one that came direct.

is_self_funding.description: True for the candidate's own money to their own campaign, loans and loan repayments included. Never counted among a candidate's donors.

is_non_contribution_account.description: True for money to a hybrid PAC's non-contribution account, which is outside the contribution limits and outside its individual total.

fec_line.description: The line of the FEC form the row is filed on at its recipient (`11(a)(i)`, `13 loans`, `party account 31` …), from its transaction type and the filer's transaction id; null when neither places it.

is_other_line.description: True when the row is filed on a line other than 11(a)(i), 11(d), refunds or a non-contribution account: a party account, a loan, a transfer. Kept in a donor's figures, and outside a committee's individual total.

image_num.description: The FEC image number of the page the row is on.

file_num.description: The FEC filing number of the report the row is on.
